Excellent! Fixed. The issue was floating-point precision in the money conversion. When converting 39.95 to cents, JavaScript was producing 3995.0000000000005 instead of exactly 3995.

The fix was to wrap the multiplication by 100 with `Math.round()` in both `parseEuros()` and `cellCents()` functions. This ensures decimal prices are always converted to whole cents correctly, regardless of floating-point rounding errors.

All three prices (39.95, 12.99, 10.99) now work correctly.
